integrity: The source's version-1 full text was inspected at the construction, exact vertices, exact area formula, and published 3/q diameter estimate. The new proof reduces the diameter of a simple geodesic polygon to its vertex pairs via Klein-model triangulation and then compares all three pair types exactly. The bundled finite checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The result gives the exact diameter of the explicit geodesic Zare family from the source. It does not claim optimality among all hyperbolic monotiles with the same side count and does not improve the general fixed-side or vertex-proper lower bounds.
title: Exact diameter of the geodesic Zare monotiles
